How it works

Paste text or choose a local text file, then convert. Matching links change in the document; the download list contains one copy of each newly converted link. Already-converted links and other URLs stay untouched.

Copy the download list into JDownloader’s LinkGrabber. Conversion only changes URL format; it does not check availability or grant access to files.

Your original file is never overwritten. Document exports retain supported imported encoding and line endings. Editing a file normalizes mixed line endings to its displayed convention.

The app does not send your document or contact linked hosts. ChatGPT hosting may record ordinary website traffic. Don’t paste secrets; only access material you’re authorized to use.
